title: JetBrains task detail shows any latest check as "Reported check passed", even a run the delivery policy does not count
description:
Found by the Wave 1 integration gate (task-808869c5, client-contract check). deliveryProjection serves latestCheckRun as {command, exitCode} of the LAST run recorded on the current candidate. It carries no `source`, and it does not say whether the run is the required gate. delivery/policy.ts counts only runner-observed exit-0 runs of the trimmed gate command.

So the detail view can read "Reported check passed - exit code 0" for an agent-reported run while qa_approve refuses required-check:<gate>. It can also show a later failing non-gate run although the gate passed. The label honestly says "Reported", but nothing tells the reader whether the policy counts that run.
definitionOfDone: The daemon projection serves the run's source and whether delivery/policy.ts counts it for the required check (or the required-check status itself), with a daemon test
JetBrains parses and renders it, pinned by a headless presentation test, and an agent-reported or non-gate pass never reads as a satisfied required check
VS Code keeps ignoring the field without error (npm test + compile)

implementationPlan.description:
TDD on the daemon projection. Do not edit policy.ts.

In packages/moe-daemon/src/state/deliveryProjection.ts (type first so tests compile):
- Extend TaskDelivery.latestCheckRun to Pick<CheckRun, 'command' | 'exitCode' | 'source'> but source optional at runtime.
- Add requiredCheckSatisfied?: boolean on TaskDelivery.

In packages/moe-daemon/src/state/deliveryProjection.test.ts:
- Update `expected.latestCheckRun` (and the later-timestamp / latest-check / WS update copies) to include `source: 'runner-observed'` matching the `check` fixture. Existing toEquals fail until checkFor copies source — that is the red proof.
- Add cases that fail on today's projection:
  1) an agent-reported exit-0 run on the current candidate is projected with source: 'agent-reported' and, under STRICT settings (copy the qualityGate/everyTask/local-branch/autoCommit true block from qaApprove.test.ts STRICT_SETTINGS via h.setupMoeFolder before load), requiredCheckSatisfied === false.
  2) a runner-observed exit-0 run of a NON-gate command (e.g. 'node lint.cjs') while qualityGate is 'node gate.cjs' → source runner-observed, requiredCheckSatisfied === false.
  3) a runner-observed exit-0 run of the trimmed gate command → requiredCheckSatisfied === true.
  4) default/legacy settings omit requiredCheckSatisfied entirely (existing expected stays without that key).
  5) resolveDeliveryPolicy throwing (unrecognised deliveryPolicy) omits requiredCheckSatisfied and does not throw — error handling for the /ws serving path. Spy or seed settings.deliveryPolicy to a junk string.

Run from packages/moe-daemon: `npx vitest run src/state/deliveryProjection.test.ts`. Expect FAIL. Skill: test-driven-development.

Implement the projection. In checkFor, when the latest valid check has source exactly 'runner-observed' or 'agent-reported', include it; otherwise omit source (do not drop command/exitCode). Do not require source in the valid() predicate.

Add requiredCheckSatisfiedFor(state, task): boolean | undefined:
- try/catch around resolveDeliveryPolicy + evaluateDeliveryEvidence (import from ../delivery/policy.js plus REQUIRED_CHECK_TOKEN_PREFIX and requiredCheckCommand). On throw, logger.debug like readEvidence and return undefined — error handling so a bad setting cannot take down the board.
- legacy → undefined.
- missingEvidence has a token starting with REQUIRED_CHECK_TOKEN_PREFIX → false.
- else if requiredCheckCommand(state, task) !== null → true.
- else undefined.
Include the field in the returned object only when the helper returns boolean.

Re-run `npx vitest run src/state/deliveryProjection.test.ts`; expect PASS.

JetBrains parse + render. Keep checkPassed/checkFailed as the Reported latest-run rows (exit 0 vs nonzero). Never use those keys for the policy verdict.

Models.kt:
- DeliveryCheckRun: add `val source: String? = null` (third param; existing two-arg call sites keep compiling).
- TaskDelivery: add `val requiredCheckSatisfied: Boolean? = null` at the end.

MoeJson.kt parseDelivery:
- latestCheckRun: parse source with getStrictStringOrNull; only keep it if it is exactly runner-observed or agent-reported, else null. A numeric/object source is already rejected by getStrictStringOrNull.
- TaskDelivery: parse requiredCheckSatisfied as JSON boolean only (true/false); string/number/null/absent → null. Error handling: never throw on a malformed extra field.

MoeJsonTest.kt: serializeNulls() will emit the new keys. Update `deliveryJson` and the malformed-nested expected JSON so round-trip stays exact (`source` / `requiredCheckSatisfied` null when absent or rejected). Add one fully-populated case: source runner-observed and requiredCheckSatisfied false round-trips byte-exactly.

DeliveryPresentation.kt: after the checkPassed/Failed row, if source is non-empty add DeliveryRow("moe.delivery.checkSource", source). If requiredCheckSatisfied == true add DeliveryRow("moe.delivery.requiredCheckCounted", "yes", outcome = PASS). If false add DeliveryRow("moe.delivery.requiredCheckNotCounted", "no", outcome = FAIL). Do not add those rows when the boolean is null. Do not change the 7-row combinatorial evidence() fixture (new fields stay null so mask 0..127 stays valid).

DeliveryPresentationTest.kt: add focused tests (do not expand the 128-mask):
- agent-reported exit 0 + requiredCheckSatisfied=false → has checkPassed AND requiredCheckNotCounted, does not have requiredCheckCounted.
- runner-observed non-gate pass + requiredCheckSatisfied=false → same.
- runner-observed gate pass + requiredCheckSatisfied=true → has requiredCheckCounted, not requiredCheckNotCounted.
- Update `every emitted bundle key has a translation`: include the new keys, bump the unique-key count from 9 to 12.

MoeBundle.properties: add
```
moe.delivery.checkSource=Reported check source
moe.delivery.requiredCheckCounted=Required check counted by policy
moe.delivery.requiredCheckNotCounted=Required check not counted by policy
```

From repo root on Windows: `cd moe-jetbrains; .\gradlew test --tests com.moe.toolwindow.DeliveryPresentationTest --tests com.moe.util.MoeJsonTest`. Expect PASS. Do not run runIde.

VS Code must keep ignoring the new fields without error. moe-vscode has no TaskDelivery type (grep latestCheckRun is empty). Do not add VS Code UI.

From moe-vscode: `npm test && npm run compile`. Expect exit 0. If compile fails on an unrelated dirty tree, say so in the step note; do not 'fix' VS Code to consume the field.

Adversarial self-review of this task's diff:
- Agent-reported or non-gate pass never produces moe.delivery.requiredCheckCounted.
- checkPassed still means reported exit 0, not policy.
- Unrecognised deliveryPolicy cannot throw from deliveryProjection.

Verification command (complete_task.verification.command), from packages/moe-daemon:
`npx vitest run src/state/deliveryProjection.test.ts`
Expect exit 0. JetBrains and VS Code commands above must also have been run green in this step (CI will re-run them; the named command is the daemon contract QA re-runs).

Skills: adversarial-self-review, verification-before-completion, regression-check.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Three options: (1) change checkPassed to only fire when policy counts the run — that lies about what the runner reported and breaks the existing 7-row combinatorial presentation test; (2) replace latestCheckRun with the policy-counted run instead of the last run — hides the later non-gate failure the ticket names; (3) keep latestCheckRun as the last reported run, add its source, and add a separate requiredCheckSatisfied boolean from evaluateDeliveryEvidence. (3) is the decision. Do not edit policy.ts (sibling task-fd970f24 owns that file). Import resolveDeliveryPolicy, requiredCheckCommand, evaluateDeliveryEvidence, REQUIRED_CHECK_TOKEN_PREFIX. VS Code has no TaskDelivery parser — extra JSON fields are ignored; the DoD is npm test + compile, not a VS Code UI change.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: deliveryProjection.ts checkFor already takes the last check on the current candidate's tree and serves {command, exitCode} only. CheckRun.source is 'runner-observed' | 'agent-reported'. evaluateDeliveryEvidence under legacy returns satisfied with no tokens; under strict, a missing required check is token required-check:<cmd>. Harness setupMoeFolder() is legacy, so existing deliveryProjection.test.ts toEquals stay green if we only ADD source onto latestCheckRun and omit requiredCheckSatisfied. JetBrains: DeliveryCheckRun(command, exitCode), parseDelivery in MoeJson.kt, DeliveryPresentation.rows uses moe.delivery.checkPassed/Failed for exit 0 vs nonzero — those labels say Reported and must stay. MoeBundle.properties has the keys. MoeJsonTest round-trips with serializeNulls(), so new optional fields defaulting to null MUST be added to the expected JSON or the first round-trip test goes red. DeliveryPresentationTest mask 0..127 covers 7 rows; new fields default null so that matrix stays valid if evidence() does not set them.
planningNotes.risks: evaluateDeliveryEvidence throws on an unrecognised deliveryPolicy — the projection must catch and omit requiredCheckSatisfied (readEvidence style); a throw takes down /ws serving. Invalid source: omit source, still serve command/exitCode. Do not require source in checkFor's valid() predicate (legacy undated rows). Sibling fd970f24 will snapshot requiredCheckAtDone; this projection should prefer evaluateDeliveryEvidence's missing-check token (the policy verdict) over live requiredCheckCommand alone, so after that sibling lands the UI still matches qa_approve. Do not edit policy.ts. Gradle tests are JUnit 4 and headless; do not launch runIde.
